IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: House State Government & Tribal Affairs (originally sponsored by Representatives Haler and Hailey)

Bill.BriefDescription: Prohibiting county and city incumbent candidates from appearing on publicly funded television during the election.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the use of publicly funded television stationsin city and county elections; and adding a new section to chapter 42.17RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 42.17 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Local government access channels shall develop policies to avoidpreferential treatment of incumbent candidates for the county or citylegislature or for city or county executive that apply beginning June1st of an election year and continue through the general election inNovember.
